name: gate
description: Stops Claude from muting checks, force pushing or reading secrets, and from saying done while build, lint or tests fail. Also checks commits and PR descriptions.

trusted_orgs.title: Trusted orgs
trusted_orgs.description: Your team's git orgs, separated by commas: `acme` for github.com/acme, or `gitlab.com/acme`. In repos with a remote in one of them, commit and PR rules apply and steps that run the repo's own code run: tests, node_modules/.bin, .venv/bin and .claude/gate.sh. Other repos still get build, vet and lint.

ticket_key.title: Require a ticket key in PR titles
ticket_key.description: Refuse a PR title without a key like ABC-123.

gate_off.title: Turn off all checks
gate_off.description: Skip every check this plugin runs: guards, lint, the repo gate, message checks, the tests check and the AI review. Same as CLAUDE_GATE_OFF=1.

guard_off.title: Turn off the guards
guard_off.description: Skip the edit guard and the command guard (force push, push to main, secrets files). Same as CLAUDE_GUARD_OFF=1.

tests_off.title: Turn off the tests check
tests_off.description: Skip the check that code changes in a Go module, Python project or TypeScript project come with a test change before gh pr create. Same as CLAUDE_TESTS_OFF=1.

review_off.title: Turn off the AI review
review_off.description: Skip the AI review of the branch before gh pr create. Same as CLAUDE_REVIEW_OFF=1.
